blocks.text: WASHINGTON, United States — A top-secret network that the US National Security Agency uses for internal communications went down Tuesday, the agency and US media reported. The NSA said it had experienced “temporary degradation during scheduled routine maintenance.” “While some internal systems were affected, mission-critical capabilities remain fully operational and our ability to defend national security continues,” an unnamed NSA spokesperson said in an e-mail response to AFP. The NSA, part of the US Department of Defense, is responsible for global monitoring, collection and processing of information for intelligence and counterintelligence.
